name: Setting Up and Using the Pi Coding Agent | DeepakNess
description: I use this alongside pi-web-access. Web search finds the information, and the browser lets me interact with live pages, read documentation on sites that need JavaScript, and check things visually. It also adds the agent_browser_web_search tool, which is a quicker way to search the web than opening a full browser page. If you already pay for a Cursor subscription, this package lets you use it inside Pi so you are not paying twice.
